Ensures the repo registry YAML matches *.mdc files on disk.

Happy path (no flags): run from the project root — validate matches the default rules directory,
or pass --write-manifest alone to regenerate the manifest after adding/renaming rule files.
Optional --rules-dir / AGENT_RULES_DIR only when rules are not under .cursor/rules.
If a workflow ever needs many steps or flags, prefer adding a thin veneer command rather than typing them every time.
Canonical manifest: .zqk/specs/configs/agent_rules_manifest.yaml.

  Validate (no flags)
  zqk system validate-agent-rules
  Refresh manifest after editing rules (one flag)
  zqk system validate-agent-rules --write-manifest
  Alternate rules directory
  zqk system validate-agent-rules --rules-dir .agent/rules

Usage:
  zqk system validate-agent-rules [flags]

Aliases:
  validate-agent-rules, validate-ide-rules

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
      --project-root string     Project root (default: resolve from cwd)
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --rules-dir string        Optional rules directory relative to project root (default .cursor/rules; overrides AGENT_RULES_DIR)
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output
      --write-manifest          Rewrite manifest from current *.mdc files (sorted)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
